$comment: Two harness gates. (1) Stop hook -> checker.mjs: every time the agent tries to finish, the deterministic gate runs — red lint/typecheck/tests block on every tier; M/L additionally require tests-with-prod-change and a fresh review verdict; S is validated against its size caps. A green pass is cached by work-tree hash, so a retry with no edits passes instantly. Fail-CLOSED (crash => keep working), capped, then escalates via gate-escalation.md. (2) PreCompact hook -> precompact-guard.mjs: before context compaction discards the window, it blocks (exit 2) if progress.md is missing/thin/unstructured/stale so the brain flushes its survival anchor first; fail-SAFE (allow on any error), capped at AI_DEV_PRECOMPACT_MAX_BLOCKS per staleness episode so it never deadlocks; no-op while ./.agent-task/ does not exist (no task in flight). The former PreToolUse read-budget hook was retired 2026-07-02 — see GATES.md.
$envComment: Lever B (CONTEXT-BUDGET.md): cap the brain's window by compacting EARLY instead of at the 1M ceiling. Claude Code computes its auto-compaction trigger as AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW * PCT_OVERRIDE/100; on Opus 4.8 BOTH vars are required (the PCT override alone won't fire proactively). 200000 * 75% => compact at ~150k, well below the 350-470k balloon and the context-rot zone. VERIFIED 2026-06-19 (B2): the brain compacted twice and peaked at 139k vs 281k un-compacted on the same meter — a clean sawtooth, ~2x token cut, no quality regression. Tune via these values; set DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT=1 to turn the whole lever off. NOTE: applies to every session launched in this folder, interactive self-dev included.
